instruction: A royal crown whose gold band and pointed arches are studded with large faceted gemstones in ruby, emerald, and sapphire. Each brilliant-cut stone splinters light into colored sparkles, and a central diamond-cut jewel crowns the peak with radiating glints.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Jeweled Crown in a gemstone-faceted style. A royal crown whose gold band and pointed arches are studded with large faceted gemstones in ruby, emerald, and sapphire. Each brilliant-cut stone splinters light into colored sparkles, and a central diamond-cut jewel crowns the peak with radiating glints. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
